metadata.name: escrow
metadata.description: You're On escrow: two-party stakes held in a PDA vault, settled by a judge key

accounts.name: appellant
docs: A party's device key; must be a loser of the stored outcome.

instructions.name: cancel_open_bet
docs: Open → Cancelled; refund A (signer: A, B or the bet's judge key).

accounts.name: party_a_token
docs: Receives the whole vault. SPL owner field == `bet.party_a` (I1, TM-F1/F4).

accounts.name: party_b_token
docs: Always receives 0 here, so it may be omitted (B may never have had an account, X6).

instructions.name: close_bet
docs: Settled / Refunded / Cancelled → closed; rent to `bet.rent_payer` (anyone).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone. Gets nothing: rent goes to `rent_payer` (TM-F9, TM-R3).

accounts.name: party_a_token
docs: Required iff the vault is non-empty (tokens donated after settlement go to A only, I1).

instructions.name: concede
docs: Resolved → Settled; the loser of a PartyA / PartyB ruling pays out at once.

accounts.name: party_a_token
docs: Required iff `to_a > 0`. SPL owner field == `bet.party_a` (I1, TM-F1/F4).

accounts.name: party_a_token
docs: Any A-owned account for the mint (normally A's ATA).

accounts.name: token_program
docs: Classic SPL Token or Token-2022 only.

accounts.name: party_a_token
docs: Required iff `to_a > 0`. SPL owner field == `bet.party_a` (I1, TM-F1/F4).

accounts.name: judge_authority
docs: Must be the bet's snapshotted `judge_authority` (I7, I11).

accounts.name: appeal_authority
docs: Must be the bet's snapshotted `appeal_authority` (I8, I11).

accounts.name: party_a_token
docs: Required iff `to_a > 0`. SPL owner field == `bet.party_a` (I1, TM-F1/F4).

instructions.name: timeout_refund
docs: Open / Locked / Appealed → Refunded (anyone, at or after that status's deadline).

accounts.name: party_a_token
docs: Required iff `to_a > 0`. SPL owner field == `bet.party_a` (I1, TM-F1/F4).

types.name: Bet
docs: One bet, PDA `["bet", bet_id]`. INIT_SPACE = 401; account = 409 bytes.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: = `create_bet` payer; receives all rent on close.

types.name: BetClosed
docs: D1: `close_bet`. Housekeeping (P8): rent back; not a "money moved" event for the UI.

fields.name: rent_returned
docs: Bet + vault lamports, read before closing.

types.name: BetStatus
docs: Borsh u8 0..=6. Variant order is frozen after the first deploy.

types.name: Config
docs: Global config, PDA `["config"]`. INIT_SPACE = 254; account = 262 bytes.

fields.name: appeal_authority
docs: Copied into each new Bet; must differ from `judge_authority`.

fields.name: accept_deadline_secs
docs: Max accept window: `create_bet`'s `accept_deadline` must be ≤ now + this.

types.name: ConfigUpdated
docs: Full post-update snapshot; identical fields to `ConfigInitialized`.

types.name: Outcome
docs: Borsh u8 0..=3. Variant order is frozen after the first deploy.

types.name: UpdateConfigArgs
docs: Every field is optional; `allowed_mints` replaces the whole list. Live bets are unaffected

constants.name: MAX_STAKE_CEILING
docs: `validate_config` bound: `stake_a + stake_b` can never overflow a `u64`.

constants.name: REQUIRED_DECIMALS
docs: Every bet mint has 6 decimals, so `max_stake` always means dollars (1 unit = $0.000001).

constants.name: VAULT_SEED
docs: Vault PDA (token account, authority = Bet PDA): `["vault", bet_id(16)]`.
